command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify pinned inputs by sha256 (the date in the DB name is NOT a byte guarantee -- the hash is the pin) =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 9cbf9ddc5b88c33f3103b56defb66b966c89f47c0988757077c651bfa6d92f6c viral_20240605.tar
  printf '%s  %s\n' 0891c00cc2d503f58e0c600ce5ee64e9c64b939525c70d5486bc46cbc7cb073e NC_045512.2.fasta
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

# A directory DB travels as one flat tar; untar it. Do NOT rm the staged tar: host /tmp is
# sticky 1777 and stage-in runs as a different user, so the container gets EPERM and rm -f
# does not suppress EPERM -- it would kill the task under set -e.
mkdir -p db
tar -xf viral_20240605.tar -C db
test -s db/hash.k2d

echo "== classify the SARS-CoV-2 genome against the viral DB =="
kraken2 --db db --output out.kraken --report out.report NC_045512.2.fasta 2> kraken2.log

# ---- smoke check: a known virus classifies to its known taxon (exact-or-wrong, deterministic) ----
STATUS=$(cut -f1 out.kraken)          # C (classified) / U (unclassified)
TAXID=$(cut -f3 out.kraken)           # LCA taxid assigned
CLASSIFIED=$(grep -c '^C' out.kraken || true)
UNCLASS=$(grep -c '^U' out.kraken || true)
{
  echo "status              $STATUS   want C (classified, not unclassified)"
  echo "assigned_taxid      $TAXID   want 2697049 (Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2)"
  echo "classified_seqs     $CLASSIFIED   want 1"
  echo "unclassified_seqs   $UNCLASS   want 0"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$STATUS" = "C"
test "$TAXID" -eq 2697049
test "$CLASSIFIED" -eq 1
test "$UNCLASS" -eq 0
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
